description: Shared conformance vectors for the Poodle headless machines. Executed by both the TypeScript core (packages/core/test/conformance.test.ts) and the Rust mirror (packages/contracts/headless/tests/conformance.rs). Effects are order-significant.

modal.name: open emits change, focus entry, scroll lock in order

hover.name: zero close delay closes immediately from opening
leave with close delay enters closing

slider.name: input snaps and clamps, emits change
commit clamps to max, emits commit

toggleGroup.name: single reselect without deactivation re-emits same value

tabs.name: focus next skips disabled and commits in automatic mode
manual mode moves focus without committing
keyboard reorder prefers the originating index
close emits request only for closable items
reorder emits complete next order and focuses the moved tab
reorder step is inert at the bound

select.name: disabled is inert
opening highlights the selected enabled option
opening without a selection highlights the first enabled option
opening with no enabled options has no highlight
repeated open emits nothing
query edit opens, reports query only, and highlights the first enabled match
query prefers the first enabled match even when the selected option also matches later
options change while open reconciles highlight without effects
options change while closed does not open
arrow prev while closed opens without a second move
arrow prev skips disabled options and clamps without wrapping
home jumps to the first enabled option
end jumps to the last enabled option
home while closed is inert
end while closed is inert
arrow next while closed opens without a second move
movement skips disabled options and clamps without wrapping
movement clamps at the last enabled option
option commit reports value, copies the label into query, and closes
enter with a highlighted option commits that option
repeated same-value commit while closed emits nothing
explicit freeform commit reports value when no option is highlighted
freeform commit is inert when an option is highlighted
freeform without searchable cannot commit query as value
close without a value change restores non-freeform query silently
escape close leaves a freeform draft query
clear reports the effective clear value and resets query without toggling
pointer highlight of a disabled option is inert

sessions.name: prepare, arm, activate, hover, drop, commit, cleanup, reset
preparation decline cancels once and late completion is inert
preparation failure cancels once
supersession cancels the first session and prepares the second
session A completion arriving after session B replaced it is inert
prepare with an operation the source does not allow is inert
activation is valid only from armed
repeated start is inert
target enter, change, and leave
operation change is limited to the source's allowed operations
a target intent naming an unsupported operation is inert
drop request requires one accepted current intent and enters dropping once
a released pointer cannot return from dropping to dragging
drop-time rejection ends the session and repeats are inert
drop failure ends the session
escape cancels a drag once
explicit cancellation cancels a drag
source loss cancels the session
target loss cancels only when it names the current intent target
transport loss cancels a pending drop
window loss cancels a pending drop
loss before pickup emits no focus return
cleanup and reset happen at most once per session
a stale event naming another session is inert

arbitration.name: the deepest containing eligible target wins
registration order breaks equal depth and equal priority
non-containing candidates are discarded however deep
ineligible candidates are discarded however deep
no eligible containing target returns no intent
an empty candidate set returns no intent
